<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.14"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="104" fill="#F5C418"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="23" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="20" x2="326" y2="20" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="337" y="16" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
  <rect x="343" y="13" width="3" height="11" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
  <rect x="349" y="10" width="3" height="14" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
  <circle cx="365" cy="17" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="362" y1="20" x2="368" y2="20" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <rect x="374" y="11" width="15" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="389" y="15" width="2" height="6" rx="1" fill="#333333"/>
  <rect x="376.5" y="13.5" width="10" height="9" rx="1.5" fill="#333333"/>

  <!-- Brand header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="43" width="64" height="30" rx="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="52" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#F5C418">IMDb</text>
    <text x="104" y="63" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Sign in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <text x="24" y="143" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Welcome back</text>
  <text x="24" y="170" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">Sign in to continue to your IMDb account.</text>

  <!-- Sign-in panel -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="194" width="350" height="355" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Email field -->
  <text x="36" y="225" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Email</text>
  <rect x="36" y="235" width="318" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#BEBEBE" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="52" y="267" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">alex.morgan@example.com</text>
  <circle cx="334" cy="260" r="9" fill="#40C173"/>
  <polyline points="329,260 333,264 340,256" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <text x="36" y="320" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Password</text>
  <rect x="36" y="330" width="318" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#BEBEBE" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="52" y="362" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">••••••••••••</text>
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="331" cy="356" rx="13" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="331" cy="356" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#646F79" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Remember and forgot -->
  <rect x="36" y="410" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="#F5C418" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="40,419 44,423 51,415" fill="none" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="64" y="424" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#333333">Remember me</text>
  <text x="354" y="424" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#333333">Forgot password?</text>

  <!-- Login button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="36" y="454" width="318" height="48" rx="8" fill="#F2C94C"/>
    <text x="195" y="484" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#333333">Login</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account divider -->
  <line x1="36" y1="579" x2="164" y2="579" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="226" y1="579" x2="354" y2="579" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="584" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#91919F">New to IMDb?</text>

  <!-- Create account button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="36" y="601" width="318" height="48" rx="8" fill="#333333"/>
    <text x="195" y="631" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Create Account</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="688" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#646F79">By continuing, you agree to IMDb's Terms of Use.</text>
  <line x1="24" y1="714" x2="366" y2="714" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,798 49,790 59,798" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="42" y="797" width="14" height="12" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Home</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Search -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="136" cy="798" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="142" y1="804" x2="148" y2="810" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="136" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Search</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Wishlist -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="221,791 225,797 232,798 227,803 228,810 221,806 215,810 216,803 211,798 218,797" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="221" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Wishlist</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="310" cy="796" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="310" cy="807" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="310" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
